request.missing_relation: Whether wind-direction changes/transitions have been tested as incremental predictors of PM2.5 episode termination or clearance after concentration history/persistence and wind speed are considered.
request.query: Crossref search terms: (PM2.5 OR particulate matter) AND (pollution episode OR haze episode) AND (clearance OR dissipation OR termination) AND (wind direction OR direction change OR wind shift) AND (persistence OR concentration history). Focus on episode endpoints and incremental comparisons, not generic PM prediction.
request.change_if_found: A close title/metadata match would downgrade the world-novelty framing and motivate checking full text for endpoint, conditioning variables, and validation design. If it tests the same contrast, revise the proposal to a distinct operational endpoint or withdraw the novelty claim. A title-only hit does not establish a shared method or result.

result.scope: Crossref metadata; original abstracts only when present
